I’m on the Metro-North and there are two people with long-haired dachshunds in bags 10 feet away from each other and the two dogs are clearly aware of each others presence but the owners are not
Reading today's sensationalized news is enough to make you worry about your own 7,000 gallon tank of methyl methacrylate, a highly flammable toxic epoxy.
Whenever Babel is in the news I reread Gen 11:6, of which, I’m afraid, I have a heretical reading.
he is at the peak of the sport
Every couple months I check in on the latest Adrian Chiles articles and I’m always absolutely blown away. These are all from the last couple months. The man is operating at an incredibly high level.
Kura Total Landscaping

“So what’s your take?”
“I’m taking this train”

from John Abromeit's appendix to this collection of Kracauer's writings on propaganda—perhaps useful to understand AI (like local news and right-wing cable news) as an addictive form of terror meant to make cognitive surrender feel like winning cup.columbia.edu/book/selecte...
geeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeez
I love the grey answers that are like “don’t change anything. the party is perfect as it is”
If there is to be any hope for the future we must eradicate fandom and bring back connoisseurship. Aspire to be a connoisseur not a fan
great now all the candidates are going to want their own Giant Election Geode

Good news in CA: @asmchrisward.bsky.social's AB 2222, a bill to help newsrooms retain and hire local journalists, passed out of the Assembly Appropriations Committee on a bipartisan 14–2 vote and added @buffywicks.bsky.social as a joint author. 

The bill heads to an Assembly floor vote next week.
I talked to Parker about my usually unsexy, often messy, but increasingly successful $$$ efforts to get more states to help fund local journalism in First Amendment-friendly ways:

🧵 Local news has long been in dire straits. Hedge funds gutted newsrooms, Big Tech swallowed ad revenue. Full communities are “news deserts” with nobody left to cover schools, corruption, police, or local government.

But a few states are testing a fix.

I wrote this piece for @damemagazine.bsky.social about local news. Thanks to @mattdpearce.com @timafranklin.bsky.social and Shamus Toomey of @blockclubchi.bsky.social for chatting with me for it:

www.damemagazine.com/2026/05/20/s...
“What do we do with thousands of papers that no human author has really thought about?”
